acceptance_conditions: deterministic repository scan covers exactly the 175 workflow definitions observed by the GitHub Actions API baseline
exactly tests.yml and ovc-tiered-tests.yml are pull_request listeners
every workflow receives exactly one governance category
temporary, historical/manual-verification and active-manual-operation categories are all represented

canonical required Python checks PASS on exact candidate head
OVC tiered FINAL_HEAD/profile, observer and stable-main merge readiness PASS on exact candidate head
